sourceType: Official Government of Punjab tourism website
note: Facts extracted below; prose summaries are written in our own words, not copied verbatim from the source.
about: Believed to be the oldest city in Punjab, spanning Harappan through Mughal periods. Largest city in the Doaba region, hub of sports goods manufacturing. Served as Punjab's capital briefly after 1947 before Shimla then Chandigarh.

places.name: Jang-e-Azadi Memorial, Kartarpur
places.facts: 25-acre Punjab freedom-movement memorial with a 45m Shaheed-e-Minar tower, galleries, amphitheatre, laser show area.

places.name: Devi Talab Mandir
places.location: Tanda Road, Shiv Nagar, Jalandhar city
places.facts: 200+ years old; one of India's 51 Shakti Pithas (goddess Tripurmalini); venue of the Harballabh Sangeet Sammelan since 125+ years, the oldest Hindustani classical music festival in India.

places.name: Tulsi Mandir
places.location: Kot Kishan Chand locality, old city, Jalandhar
places.facts: Ancient temple, originally to Vrinda, wife of the demon Jalandhara; adjacent tank said to be his bathing place.

places.name: Shiv Mandir, Gur Mandi
places.facts: Reputedly built by a Nawab of Sultanpur Lodhi; unusual mosque-style gate.

places.name: Tombs of Ustad-Shagird (Momin and Haji Jamal), Nakodar
places.facts: Mughal-era mausoleums; Tomb of Mohammed Momin built 1612 AD (Jahangir era, tambura player under Khan-i-Khanan); Tomb of Haji Jamal built 1657 AD. Both ASI-protected.

places.name: Nurmahal Sarai (Nur Mahal)
places.location: Nurmahal town, ~30km from Jalandhar, ~12km from Nakodar
places.facts: Mughal caravanserai built 1619-1621 by Nawab Zakariya Khan, named after Nur Jahan; 140 cells around a quadrangle, ASI-protected.

places.name: Dakhni Sarai
places.location: Village Dakhni, Nakodar-Kapurthala road, ~12km from Nakodar
places.facts: Mughal caravanserai built c.1640 by Ali Mardan Khan; 124 cells, a mosque and well inside; ASI-protected.

places.name: Mughal Bridge, Mahlian Kalan
places.location: South of village Mahlian Kalan, Nakodar-Kapurthala road
places.facts: Shah Jahan-era bridge (1627-1658) over the Dhauli-veni river; 5 arched spans in Lakhauri brick; ASI-protected.

places.name: Gurdwara Talhan Sahib Ji
places.facts: Honors Guru Hargobind Sahib Ji's visit; white marble and sandstone architecture.

places.name: Gurdwara Thamm Sahib, Kartarpur
places.facts: SGPC-listed historic Gurdwara in the town Guru Arjan Dev Ji founded.

places.name: Sodal Mandir (Baba Sodal)
places.facts: Temple to Baba Sodal; annual September mela.

places.name: St. Mary's Cathedral
places.facts: Blends Indian/European design; under the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Delhi.

places.name: Rangla Punjab Haveli
places.facts: Cultural complex showcasing traditional Punjabi life, crafts and food.

places.name: Pushpa Gujral Science City
places.facts: 72-acre joint Central/Punjab government science park; laser show, flight simulator, digital planetarium.

places.name: Nehru Park & Chohal Dam
places.facts: City green space and an eco-tourism dam site.

howToReach.rail: Jalandhar City Railway Station, major junction
howToReach.road: Jalandhar City Bus Stand, on NH1/Grand Trunk Road
